page_title: TOR 2-0 UDI | Torino v Udinese 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Giuseppe Collu didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+2' Rui Modesto (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Giuseppe Collu shows the yellow card to Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adrien Tameze (Torino) will replace Cesare Casadei.
87' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:10.

85' 2 - 0 Goal! Ali Dembele (Torino) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Maduka Okoye is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:0.
83' Here is a change. Martin Payero is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Alexis Sanchez (Udinese).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Damian Pizarro (Udinese) replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.

82' Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino). Giuseppe Collu doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
79' Keinan Davis (Udinese) meets a cross inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
78' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rui Modesto (Udinese), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Masina departs the field of play to be replaced by Ali Dembele (Torino).
76' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Eljif Elmas is replaced by Sergiu Perciun (Torino).
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.

74' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
74' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
72' Martin Payero (Udinese) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
71' The substitution is prepared. Simone Pafundi (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sandi Lovric.
68' 3:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
66' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Rui Modesto (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Udinese have a corner.
66' Martin Payero (Udinese) attempts to find Sandi Lovric, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
64' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who smothers the ball. Udinese force a corner. They send men into the box.
64' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Samuele Ricci and he is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
63' Substitution. Marcus Pedersen is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino).
63' Kingsley Ehizibue comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rui Modesto (Udinese).
63' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Keinan Davis (Udinese) replaces Iker Bravo.
62' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Udinese will take a corner kick.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.

60' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

60' Torino are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The ball goes out of play and Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
59' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' Iker Bravo (Udinese) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

55' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Sandi Lovric (Udinese) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
55' Iker Bravo (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Iker Bravo (Udinese) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
52' The ball is cleared after Che Adams (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' The possession of the ball – 47:53.
50' Udinese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
48' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
47' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Che Adams (Torino) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Neat passing move from Torino in order to create new attacking opportunities.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Che Adams (Torino) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
39' Samuele Ricci (Torino) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Maduka Okoye.
38' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Guillermo Maripan (Torino) is given a yellow card.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.
38' Torino are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
35' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Arthur Atta (Udinese) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
30' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Udinese are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.
28' The foul by Che Adams (Torino) was seen by Giuseppe Collu who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
26' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Torino get a corner.
26' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) will take the corner.
25' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
24' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:0.
22' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
21' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
17' One of the players from Torino times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Samuele Ricci (Torino) will deliver the corner kick.
12' Torino fail to score from a corner as Maduka Okoye (Udinese) leaps to collect the ball. The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Samuele Ricci (Torino) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
10' Iker Bravo (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 30:70.

8' Arthur Atta (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
6' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
4' Iker Bravo (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Iker Bravo (Udinese) takes the corner but it's cleared.

3' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Giuseppe Collu got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
